Manage named Instances through external Drivers

Usage:
  inframill [flags]
  inframill [command]

Local commands:
  driver      Inspect local Drivers and run Driver protocol entry points
  exec        Execute locally and stream the verified result
  history     Read existing local Instance command history
  server      Start the daemon using required application configuration

Daemon commands:
  blueprint   Manage blueprint resources
  command     Manage command resources
  instance    Manage instance resources

Utilities:
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  help        Help about any command
  version     Print the core release version

Flags:
      --color string   human output color: auto, always or never (default "auto")
  -h, --help           help for inframill
  -v, --version        version for inframill

Use "inframill [command] --help" for more information about a command.
